decision.scope: Electronic LiD BO stopping reused for LiT at the same volume; unchanged D-on-Li6 plus D-on-T ZBL. This is the declared model, not measured LiT loss or a physical gain verdict.

envelope: Seven-control observed L1 envelope; nonnegative electronic lower bound, not statistical coverage or an infinite-basis bound.

half_reference_threshold.inference: Sampled brackets, not interpolated exact roots; all reentrant crossings retained. A settings envelope and model omissions must be assessed separately.

literal_bridge.applicability: Literal IAEA2026-09 proton rows, interpolation within each observed range only. No scaling or normalization fit. Li+oneH per formula, H2 source already per atom, gas/metal Bragg compound approximation.
literal_bridge.availability: Ep1995 and Ph1953 primary editions unavailable; these are source-tabulated compilation claims, not unseen primary tables. Bs1979 original monograph Fig5 p16 read; its stated2.5percent two-sigma differs from compiled1.3percent unspecified error.
literal_bridge.diagnostic_25keV: Native loss query retained; below the first Li table datum at equal velocity, so no measured-data extrapolation.
literal_bridge.normalization_caveat: Ep1995 compilation differs from both ICRU-code parametrization at low velocity and Bader1956 high-energy values. No silent correction; original Ep1995 body remains unavailable.
literal_bridge.uncertainty: Retain original percentage_error text; no automatic conversion to one sigma.

returns: E_cut0.1keV retained. Eq7 bare/Ue0.84/1.4keV keeps the unshifted D-T S-factor and ZBL nuclear stopping. ICRU-model bridge above25.1keV is untuned; literal measured-compilation bridge fails30percent. All physical returns remain conditional.
